Group rides in Atlanta, GA

6 recurring group rides around Atlanta, GA: 4 road, 2 social. 5 roll on weeknights, 0 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Critical Mass Atlanta in Atlanta — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Bike Roswell! Wednesday Evening Ride runs a 18+ mph, B 16–17 mph, C 14–15 mph.
